sloka: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नागास्ते विप्रदुद्रुवुः ।यैस्तौ सत्पुरुषौ बद्धौ शरभूतैर्महाबलौ ।। ६.५०.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: tamāgatamabhiprekṣya nāgāste vipradudruvuḥ ।yaistau satpuruṣau baddhau śarabhūtairmahābalau ।। 6.50.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the noble Rama and Lakshmana bound by the serpents in the form of arrows (released by Indrajith), the serpents fled.
